chunks: Al-Qasim ibn Yahya narrated from his grandfather al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Ya'qub al-Ju'fi, who said:

I heard Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام say: “There is no harm in withdrawal in six cases: the woman who is certain that she does not bear children, the elderly woman, the ill-tempered woman, the obscene woman, the woman who does not nurse her child, and the bondwoman.”

key_terms.أَيْقَنَتْ: she became certain; she knows with certainty

ai.seo_question: In which cases is withdrawal (ʿazl) permitted according to Imam Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a legal ruling concerning the permissibility of withdrawal (coitus interruptus) in six specified cases. It is significant in Shia fiqh as a concise narration addressing marital and reproductive law within defined circumstances.
